programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 在最重視了解自然災害和吉凶的日本有著世界上最古老的調查機構「全領域異常解決辦公室」以解決難以想像的「無法解釋的異常案件」。但似乎隱藏著一個巨大的秘密. .....人們面對的「異常事件」，例如無法用科學解釋的超自然現象。這是一個可能真實發生在你身邊的故事。甚麼是真實的，甚麼是虛構的？ 真相在下一刻就變成了妄想。

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 三位51歲、對人生感到失意的中年大叔——吉井雄太、藤卷肇與菊原紀介，因故鄉傳來「工地挖出人骨」的新聞而重聚。他們原是少年時代的電影研究部夥伴，卻在回憶往昔時，驚覺他們的女顧問老師竟被標註為「行方不明」。這個發現，點燃了他們追查老師神祕失蹤真相的決心，也開啟了一段重新檢視自我與青春的救贖之旅。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 大學時期的男主角月岡夏，與同學南雲水季交往起來，並過著幸福的日子。然而，正當他們都在忙著就業活動的時候，水季卻突然向他提出分手，從此兩人分道揚鑣。就這樣過了七年，已經開展新生活的夏，卻突然收到大學時代朋友的通知，原來水季已經離開了人世。從分手那天起就沒有再見過水季的夏，帶著難以置信的心情去參加了水季的葬禮。在葬禮上，夏見到了一個名叫海的小女孩，並得知她是水季和他的女兒，讓他感到十分震驚。原來當年水季竟瞞著他生下了他們的孩子，並且一直默默地撫養著這個孩子。知道這一切以後，夏開始思考水季和海在這七年間的生活。

programme.desc: 醫學院輟學生李宇謙涉嫌綁架殺害223人，卻宣稱掌握「治癒所有疾病」的技術。如今這項只存在他腦中的奇蹟，成為要挾世界的籌碼：「赦免我，否則帶著秘密進墳墓」。同時絕望律師為救患有腦瘤的女兒，必須保護兇手。而正義檢察官卻為223條冤魂，誓死送他上刑場。二人的博弈一觸即發。李宇謙究竟是冷血殺手，還是人類的救星？

programme.title: E3 - Perche-Style Feijoada

programme.title: E24 - The Charm Of A Winter In Corsica
programme.desc: Winter in Corsica is an invitation to discover an island with a beating heart, far from the summer crowds. A season when the true Corsican soul is revealed, between preserved traditions and moments of shared conviviality. The ideal time to appreciate the true Corsican art of living and its ancestral traditions.

programme.title: E14 - Simone Pheulpin/Julian Klausner/Sophie Brillouet
programme.desc: The Albert-Kahn museum unveils the banker's humanist project. Sometimes called 'the time folder', Simone Pheulpin works with cotton ribbon. For his first show at Dries Van Noten, Julian Klausner plays with textures and colours. Sophie Brillouet's studio is alive with beach air.

programme.title: E4 - Ice
programme.desc: Trek to the planet’s quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

programme.title: E4 - Hunkering Down
programme.desc: Winter is coming, and the animals take advantage of autumn’s final bounty before the cold, barren months ahead. Watch some creatures search for respite indoors, while others arrive from far northern climates to settle in the ploughed fields.

programme.title: E3 - Age of Independence
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: E2 - Snake Face Off
programme.desc: Launch into spring’s snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. Stand back as Dan and Jess rescue chickens from a python, and Mick and Adele hunt for a rogue green tree snake.

programme.title: E6 - Home Invasion
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: E2 - Double Trouble
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: E2 - Operation Pelican
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who’s swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: E3 - Interior
programme.desc: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

programme.desc: Celebrate Cash the house donkey’s birthday, then play hide-and-seek with Milton the skunk. Meet Bjornar the beaver, who has a very important job, and explore the importance of cuddles and naps with Bentley the tree kangaroo and his human mum.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide
programme.desc: Low tide exposes a band of shore called the intertidal zone. It’s a place of stunning extremes, attacked by hurricane force waves and exposed to baking heat. Creatures here have evolved in countless bizarre ways. Scientists explore this alien realm.

programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: E2 - Operation Pelican
programme.desc: Head out with rescuer Jo to scoop up a pelican who’s swallowed a fish hook, then see Sam free a newborn bat tangled in a fence. Follow vet Tim, who aids a surly koala with an eye infection, and watch a lumpy python give newbie Ruby a load of trouble.

programme.title: E3 - Interior
programme.desc: Some of the most interesting adaptations in the animal world are completely invisible. Study these hidden, internal alterations to see how different animals have evolved to survive in amazing and unseen ways.

programme.title: E1 - Raw Power

programme.title: Kingdom of the Tide

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E5
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E12
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.desc: 講述了大學畢業三年後，羅豔（李庚希飾）經媽媽介紹進入一家離家不遠的傳統型公司做閒差，別人羨慕她輕鬆悠閒，她卻厭倦了枯燥的生活；出入高檔寫字樓的姜小果（卜冠今飾）實際上每天加班沒有自己的生活；突如其來的家庭經濟危機讓段家寶（董思怡飾）從「富二代」變成了「負二代」；梁爽（關曉彤飾）成了全網頂尖的美妝護膚主播，但她的事業起起伏伏。儘管生活的路總是令人困惑而踟躕，但女孩們從不停止向前的腳步。這是充滿艱難，也充滿光明的25歲。

programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E1 - Learning to Do the Right Thing!
programme.desc: Join Buster as he learns to do the right thing! When Buster accidentally breaks the class flower, he panics & tries to cover it up, but soon learns that telling the truth is always the best thing to do. Then, when he & Daddy spot a steam train speeding out of control, they know they have to do the right thing! They race after the train & save the day! From cleaning up his toys to helping a puppy, Buster is always trying to do the right thing.

programme.title: E4 - Fun Facts About The World!
programme.desc: Blippi is learning fun facts all about the world! He & D.BO shrink down to meet Ernie the Eraser, an aspiring magician who teaches them the science behind how erasers work. Then, they fly into the night sky to learn how fireworks get their colors & why some animals, like raccoons, prefer to come out at night. The adventure continues as Blippi learns how to be a cowboy in the desert & helps a brave spoon protect his cereal from getting soggy!

programme.title: E3 - Mia & The Bus's Art Day
programme.desc: Get arty with Little Baby Bum this August! Help Mia and her friends paint a huge mural of The Bus. Then, bake yummy muffins with Rose, play BINGO with the whole family, and have a dino-tastic snack time in a pretend Dinosaur Cafe!

programme.title: E2 - Mia & Max's Artsy August Picnic
programme.desc: Have an Artsy August picnic! Join Mia and Max for some messy painting, then put on a performance of Humpty Dumpty. Create a Dinosaur Cafe for snacks, learn about families, and play This Little Piggy after a fun day in the garden!

programme.title: E1 - The Ultimate Teamwork & Rescue Special!
